Queixada.prompt: A single wild white-lipped peccary (queixada), stocky body with dark bristly fur, a white patch on its jaw, small sharp tusks, charging head-on through dense Amazon rainforest undergrowth at night, mud splashing.

Veado Branco.prompt: A single ghostly pure white deer stag with small antlers and glowing red eyes, standing still in a dark Amazon forest clearing, thin mist around its legs, eerie and silent.

Vitória-régia.prompt: A single giant Amazon water lily (Victoria amazonica): one huge round floating leaf with a raised rim and one open white-and-pink flower in the center, on a dark still river under a full moon, soft moonlight glow on the water.

Aruanã.prompt: A single silver arowana fish (aruanã) with a long body, large shiny scales and two chin barbels, leaping out of a dark Amazon river at dusk, water droplets around it.

Espírito.prompt: A single translucent glowing green spirit of an Indigenous Brazilian ancestor, an adult man with a feather headdress, his body made of soft light and smoke, rising from a feathered gourd rattle (maraca) lying on the ground of a dark rainforest.

Osso Erguido.prompt: A single standing adult human skeleton, newly reassembled, with stylized sinews and dry muscle starting to form over the bones, no blood, standing upright in a desert valley covered with scattered dry bones under a dramatic sky with wind.

Xiaotian Quan, Cão Celestial.prompt: A single large sleek black Chinese celestial hunting dog (Xiaotian Quan) with glowing golden eyes, a small red collar with a golden bell, white cloud wisps swirling around its paws, leaping down stone steps of a mountain gate with pines under a cold full moon.

Strix.prompt: A single strix, a dark owl-like bird of ill omen with ragged black-grey feathers, large glowing yellow eyes and sharp talons, wings spread wide, perched on a twisted walnut tree branch above an old Italian village at night.

Corvo.prompt: A single large black raven with glossy blue-black feathers and a heavy beak, wings spread, flying low over a misty ancient Irish battlefield at dusk with broken spears in the grass.

Lebre.prompt: A single brown hare, a witch's familiar, standing upright on its hind legs with long ears raised, in a moonlit meadow on Walpurgis night, a distant bonfire on a mountain behind it.

Espírito de Paimon.prompt: A single small spirit servant made of golden light and dark smoke, a slender winged humanoid figure without a face, blowing a long brass trumpet, floating above a chalk magic circle on a dark stone floor.

Elemental.prompt: A single small fire elemental, a humanoid figure made entirely of living flames and glowing embers, standing inside a glowing chalk magic circle on a dark stone floor in an occult study.
